name: peppol-invoices
description: Explain why this invoice export is rejected and give my invoicing provider the exact fixes. Reviews supplied Peppol BIS Billing invoice or credit-note exports, rejection text and described screenshots. Returns field corrections, arithmetic and a provider-ready handoff. No account connection or transmission is required.
